title: Pending tools — row
description: Row schema for datasets/pending-tools/pending-tools.json (field `rows`) and its CSV twin. This list never contains prices, free-tier figures or commercial-use conclusions. License: CC BY-SA 4.0 — attribution required: AMPM-AIOPS 問問貓 (ampm-aiops.com)

tool_id.description: Stable identifier, unique in this list.

name.description: Tool name as recorded. When no name is on record the identifier is shown and notes say so.

official_homepage.description: Filled only when the official domain was confirmed; otherwise null. Never a guessed domain.

status.description: Where the tool stands. See docs/pending-tools.md for the meaning of each value.

gap_category.description: Main gap, one of eight fixed categories; null when our records do not say which one applies.

missing_fields.description: Which verifiable facts are still missing.

exclusion_reason.description: Neutral, reproducible reason the tool is not in the published dataset (zh-Hant).

last_checked_at.description: Date of the last check on record (YYYY-MM-DD).

recheck_at.description: Planned re-check date; null when none is scheduled.

source_urls.description: Public sources actually confirmed. Empty when there is none; never a guessed URL.

notes.description: Known facts only (zh-Hant); null when there is nothing to add.
